evaluations.evidence: I want to search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting.
evaluations.rationale: Means states a feature but story lacks an end that explains why this feature is valuable (no rationale).

evaluations.evidence: I want to search and discover music based on my profile.
evaluations.rationale: Means expresses a feature but there is no end/rationale explaining the benefit of this feature.

evaluations.evidence: I want to search and discover music based on other users similar to myself.
evaluations.rationale: Feature is stated but the story provides no rationale (why this is valuable).

evaluations.evidence: I want to search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity.
evaluations.rationale: Means states the feature but no end/rationale explains the value of the feature.

evaluations.evidence: I want to search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags, so that I find related artists, new genre, or other relevant listening path.
evaluations.rationale: Means expresses the feature and the 'so that' clause gives clear rationale (find related artists, new genres, listening paths).

evaluations.evidence: I want to upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps.
